Top 10 Semiconductor Manufacturing Companies in Europe 2025

Jan 6, 2025 | By The Desk

Europe's chip companies supply parts that phones, cars and factories cannot do without.

Best Semiconductor Manufacturing in Europe

Here are the Top 10 semiconductor manufacturing companies in Europe. 

  • Best Semiconductor Manufacturing in Europe
  • ASML
  • NXP Semiconductors
  • SOITEC
  • Aixtron
  • X- Fab
  • Infineon
  • STMicroelectronics
  • Technoprobe
  • BE Semiconductor
  • Melaxis
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)
    • Which are Top 10 Semiconductor Manufacturing Companies in Europe ?
    • Where is Melaxis based ?

ASML

ASML builds the lithography machines that print the finest patterns on chips.

Read also - Top 10 B2B Ecommerce startups in Europe 

Its customers are the largest chip factories in the world.

NXP Semiconductors

NXP Semiconductors designs chips for cars and payment cards from its home in the Netherlands.

It has plants in Europe, Asia and America.

SOITEC

Soitec makes engineered wafers that other chipmakers build on.

Its materials end up in phones, cars, data centres and medical devices.

Aixtron 

Aixtron is a German maker of deposition equipment for compound semiconductors.

Read also - Top 10 Best AdTech startups in Europe

It sells to makers of LEDs and power chips.

X- Fab

X Fab is a German foundry that makes analog and mixed-signal chips for other companies.

Read also - Top 20 Electric Vehicle (EV) Startups in Europe

Most of its output goes to car and industrial customers.

Infineon 

Infineon makes power semiconductors and microcontrollers near Munich.

Read also - Top 10 HealthTech startups in Europe

Cars, security and industry are its main markets.

STMicroelectronics

STMicroelectronics is a French-Italian chipmaker with its head office in Switzerland.

Read also - Top 10 Defence Tech Startups in Europe

It makes sensors, microcontrollers and power chips.

Technoprobe 

Technoprobe is an Italian maker of the probe cards used to test chips.

Read also - Top 10 European Gaming Startups

It spends heavily on research.

BE Semiconductor

BE Semiconductor is a Dutch maker of the machines that package chips.

Read also - Top EdTech Startups in Europe

Its hybrid bonding tools are in demand for AI chips.

Melaxis 

Melaxis is a Belgian maker of sensor chips.

Read also - List of Unicorn Startups in Europe

Most of what it makes goes into cars.

Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Which are Top 10 Semiconductor Manufacturing Companies in Europe ?

ASML, NXP Semiconductors, SOITEC, Aixtron, X- Fab, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Technoprobe, BE Semiconductor, and Melaxis are Top 10 Semiconductor Manufacturing Companies in Europe.

Where is Melaxis based ?

Melaxis is based in Belgium.
